messages:
alexa: FYI billing flagged a small batch where Console shows project=infra-helpers but token introspect had project=partner-lumen. feels like attribution inconsistency after the proxy merge
mohit: confirmed in traces. proxy still writes X-Project for legacy integrators and some downstream pieces (Console, quota service) prefer header-first
carla: that leads to wrong quota accounting and scrambled cost dashboards. can we pick a single canonical source?
alexa: proposal: use validated token claim `project` as canonical when present, fall back to X-Project header only if claim missing. also introduce an org-level compatibility toggle for legacy partners
mohit: implementation plan: auth-exchange will compute X-Effective-Project early and set precedence: token.claim.project -> org_legacy_flag -> X-Project header -> anonymous. add a feature-flag to gate rollout per-cluster
carla: telemetry first: emit `effective_project_source{source:introspect|header|none}` and `effective_project_mismatch_total`. sample traces for mismatch cases (cap 1/sec/org) so support/PM can audit who relies on headers
alexa: UX: request inspector should show "Attribution: token claim (validated)" or "Attribution: header (legacy)". if mismatch show a small info pill with link to migration docs; avoid scary warnings
mohit: rollout steps: 1) add metrics + dashboards 2) unit & integration tests 3) behind FF (1% -> 10% -> 100%) with 48h observation windows 4) enable org toggle for whitelisted orgs and default OFF for new orgs
carla: alerting: abort if `effective_project_mismatch_total` spikes >5x baseline OR any single project quota burn delta >20%/hour during canary. billing-team: can you monitor and standby?
billing-team: yes. ping us 24h before canary with runbook & we will watch billing connectors and invoice signals. add an automated daily top-20 mismatch digest for PMs
mohit: BC/comms: send migration guide + example JWTs showing `project` claim, and a short SDK snippet for servers to mint or exchange tokens. recommend 90-day deprecation notice before flipping defaults for existing orgs
alexa: created INF-12345 to track: "Canonicalize effective project to validated token claim; telemetry + org compatibility toggle"
auth-bot: Created INF-12345: "Canonicalize effective project to validated token claim" assigned to mohit, alexa
mohit: I'll open the PR with unit tests and dashboard links. will add FF wiring and per-cluster toggle for fast rollback
carla: thanks. keep PR/runbook links in INF-12345 and keep this thread for quick sync only
alexa: cheers, will post the canary plan in #release-war-room once PR is ready
mohit: starting work now, linking back shortly
